headline: UK Competition Watchdog Calls for Shake-up of Private Dentistry Market
summary: The UK's competition watchdog has called for a shake-up of the 8 billion pound private dentistry market after an investigation identified inflation-busting annual rises and sales targets.
why: Private healthcare markets are subject to regulatory scrutiny to ensure fair pricing and consumer protection, directly impacting private operators and patients.

impacts.name: Healthcare Services
impacts.why: Regulatory scrutiny of private dentistry may lead to policy or pricing changes across the sector.
